description: Render a generation card: its prompt and model become a video or image job whose result lands in the card. Requires a quote_id from estimate_credit_cost for the card's model and kind (quantity 1), taken with the card's duration and resolution when it has them: per-second models are priced from those, and the quote is verified against the card. A card added with from_card_id and no image_url starts from its source card's finished image; until that card is done the run is refused with nothing charged. Credits are charged only on success; a retry with the same quote_id returns the same job. SIGN-IN REQUIRED: connect this server with OAuth (the host prompts for it), or add an API key header "Authorization: Bearer acd_live_…" created at https://aicontentdrop.com/settings/integrations.

canvas_id.description: The board id, from list_canvases or create_canvas.

card_id.description: A generation card with a model and a prompt.

quote_id.description: The quote_id from estimate_credit_cost for this card's model and kind, quoted with the card's duration and resolution when it has them. Required.

revision.description: The board revision this change is based on (from the last board you saw). Optional: when omitted the tool reads the current one first.

name: run_generation_card

data.description: Per type. text: { text, title?, color? }. media: { url, kind, title?, caption?, source? }. generation: { model?, prompt?, kind, status (draft | queued | generating | done | failed), job_id?, media_url?, credits_used?, error? }. frame: { label, width, height }. task: { taskId }.

items.description: A connection drawn from one card to the next: { id, source, target, label? }. data.role start_image means the source card's finished image is the target card's start frame.

label.description: Text drawn on the line, when it has one.

source.description: The card the connection starts from.

link.description: The board's page on AI Content Drop.

revision.description: The board's version; every write bumps it.
